title: Anchor-cohort automated validation scaffold for FP8/INT8 rollouts
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an automated validation scaffold that evaluates FP8/INT8 quantized model variants against curated anchor prompt cohorts and dynamic metrics to produce deterministic pass/fail gates for rollout pipelines.
background: We currently run ad-hoc calibration checks and bespoke accuracy spot-checks for quant rollouts. Existing harnesses overlap heavily in tooling and rely on 'golden' nomenclature; this task pilots an anchor-cohort approach with contextual thresholds, per-layer variance scoring, and CI-native gates that can be reused by runtime and Dedicated teams.
goals: Provide a deterministic, reproducible validation run that can be invoked from CI or the console rollout flow
Support FP8 and INT8 candidate binaries and their calibration profiles (per-layer scales, bias compensation)
Introduce anchor prompt cohorts that represent production traffic slices and adversarial perturbations
Define composite pass/fail gates combining semantic similarity, token-level divergence, and performance regressions
Emit telemetry compatible with Console dashboards and automated rollback hooks
success_criteria: Validation scaffold can run end-to-end in CI under 45 minutes for the medium anchor cohort
Aggregated pass/fail decision generated and stored as a signed artifact (signed JSON) for audit
Observed false-positive rate on historical rollouts < 2% when compared to manual QA annotations
Integration with rollout pipeline to block canary->prod promotion when gate fails
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible job definition (GitHub Action and Kubernetes Job template) that runs on a commit or model build
Dataset: three anchor cohorts (core-production, sensitive-linguistic, adversarial-perturb) with provenance and sample sizing metadata
Metrics: embedding cosine similarity baseline, token-KL divergence, majority edit-distance, response-length distribution, p95 latency delta and throughput cost delta
Gate logic: configurable JSON defining per-metric thresholds and weighted aggregator producing PASS|FAIL
Artifacts: human-readable report and machine-readable signed gate artifact uploaded to storage and linked in the build status
Dashboards: telemetry emitted to Console metrics and a traceable log stored for 90 days
design_notes: We will use 'anchor' instead of 'golden' to emphasize cohort diversity. Anchor cohorts include production-sampled prompts (anonymized), synthetic adversarial perturbations, and a small hand-curated sensitive set. Scoring combines semantic-sim (OpenAI-like embedding cosine using reference model), token-KL to detect distribution shifts, and a fuzzy-match score for expected structured outputs. Gate weights will be per-project and default to conservative thresholds for FP8. Canary invocation should run the scaffold with stochastic seeds fixed to produce deterministic results; where nondeterminism exists (sampling decoding) we use top-k/top-p seeds or compare multiple seeds and use median metrics.
implementation_tasks: ENG-240002: Define anchor cohort schema and produce initial CSV manifests (core-production, sensitive, adversarial)
ENG-240010: Implement CI job (GitHub Actions) wrapper that pulls candidate model, calibration profile, and runs harness
ENG-240011: Build scoring library: embedding-based semantic similarity, token-KL, edit-distance, structured-field matcher
ENG-240012: Gate engine: JSON-driven weighted aggregator with sign-off signature generation
ENG-240013: Integrate telemetry exporter for Console (metrics + traces) and S3 artifact uploader
ENG-240014: Add Canary pipeline hook and rollback playbook integration
ENG-240015: E2E tests using a known-good baseline and a purposely-degraded INT8 variant to verify failure behavior
test_plan: Run harness locally with the small anchor cohort first (smoke), then in CI against nightly INT8/FP8 builds. Use seeded sampling to ensure determinism. Validate metrics against historical baseline runs (stored under /artifacts/anchor-baselines/) and run manual QA on a stratified sample when scaffold reports FAIL. Add a synthetic drift injection test that modifies token probability mass for certain tokens and asserts gate catches degradation.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal validation runs on feature branch. Phase 2: attach to experimental canaries (10% traffic) blocking promotion when FAIL. Phase 3: release as runtime-1.22 gating tool for FP8 rollouts. Include opt-out for teams during migration window.
monitoring_telemetry: Emit per-run aggregated metrics: semantic_cosine_median, semantic_cosine_p05, token_KL_mean, edit_distance_median, latency_p95_delta, throughput_cost_delta. Also emit per-prompt anomalies and store top-10 diffs for human review. All metrics tagged with model_version, calibration_profile_id, anchor_cohort_id, and run_id.
dependencies: ENG-215000: storage & signing infra for signed gate artifacts
ENG-189001: model packaging pipeline to produce quant candidate images
